code_review.meaning: The reviewed source correctly implements the fail-closed mechanics that are currently specified. This status is explicitly not permission to start formal training and is not evidence that SCTSR is effective.

hard_blockers.required_action: Research owner must approve and hash-freeze a preregistration addendum. The recommended candidate is minimum-displacement zero-overlap matching, but it changes the R2 estimand and has not been authorized.
Provision the signed matrix release, frozen 8-seed discovery registry, per-job one-use tokens and a shared canonical execution-claim registry only after R2 is frozen.

phase_specific_hold.scope: A/gradient-alignment and later Q/R/A/D phases only
phase_specific_hold.required_action: Do not enable A until an independent, group-disjoint, SHA-frozen val_target is registered.

formal_training_readiness.next_decision: Approve one R2 addendum or reject the eight-arm matrix. No code path may silently choose on behalf of the research owner.
